reason: The plugin is primarily a document-processing utility for users, because it adds an Export Chat action in DeepSeek Harness Web that generates and downloads a Markdown file for the current conversation, focusing on readable transcripts (human messages and final assistant answers) and excluding backend/debug artifacts as described in the README and plugin metadata.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中提供“导出聊天”功能，可将当前会话导出为 Markdown 文件，便于阅读和记录。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an Export Chat action in DeepSeek Harness Web to produce a session-only Markdown export for reading and handoff.

capabilities: Export the active DeepSeek Harness conversation from the web session into a Markdown file.
Adds a new Export Chat action in the DSH Web session UI.
Downloads a session-scoped Markdown artifact with conversation content.
Omits internal runtime/tool metadata from the exported transcript.

reasons.code: Export Chat action is added to the DSH session UI and targets the current session
Repository package declares DSH web client plugin configuration and bundle injection
Output format and scope are defined as session Markdown downloads only
Privacy note states local-only export path with no upload/cloud path stated
